post.description:
Quantize images onto a smaller, shared palette.

Pixel art reads as pixel art partly because of its restricted palette. AI output
and converted artwork often carry hundreds of near-identical colors; this snaps
them onto a tight palette, optionally with ordered dithering.

Passing several frames in one call is the point of the endpoint: they are
quantized together, so an animation or a character's eight directions come back
sharing ONE palette instead of drifting apart frame by frame.

Three ways to choose the palette:
- omit `num_colors` and `palette_image` — the palette size is auto-detected
- `num_colors` — quantize to exactly this many colors
- `palette_image` — reuse the colors of an existing image (your game's palette)

Total size limit across all frames is 512x512 worth of pixels (e.g. sixteen
64x64 frames, or four 128x128).

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.pixellab.ai/v2/reduce-colors \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"images": [{"base64": "..."}, {"base64": "..."}], "num_colors": 16}'
```

images.title: Images
images.description: Image(s) to quantize (PNG base64). Several frames are quantized together onto ONE shared palette and must all be the same size — pass an animation's frames or a character's directions in one call so their colors stay consistent.

num_colors.title: Num Colors
num_colors.description: Target number of colors. Omit to auto-detect a good palette size from the image itself. Mutually exclusive with palette_image.

palette_image.description: An image whose colors become the palette (max 256 colors). Use it to force frames onto an existing game palette. Mutually exclusive with num_colors.

dithering.title: Dithering
dithering.description: Ordered dithering matrix size. Larger matrices give smoother gradients at the cost of a busier look.

dithering_strength.title: Dithering Strength
dithering_strength.description: How strongly to dither. Ignored when dithering is 'none'.

ReduceColorsRequest.title: ReduceColorsRequest
ReduceColorsRequest.description: Request model for the reduce-colors endpoint

name.title: Name
name.description: The palette's name ('Game Boy', 'PICO-8'); helps the look.

max_colors.title: Max Colors
max_colors.description: At most this many colours in each image (from colors if given).

smart.title: Smart
smart.description: Beta, single images only: put each object on the palette as a whole (a face stays skin-coloured, wood stays brown) instead of giving every pixel its nearest colour. Needs colors; adds about 15-60 s.

TargetPalette.title: TargetPalette
TargetPalette.description: Colours the result must use (colors) and/or at most max_colors per image.
